Maine aapke lounge ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur party inquiries integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lbw

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Lounge Before Wicket) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first menu showcase for your Patna location near Urja Stadium. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain.
